alertes.methodology_intro: An alert flags a topic whose salience peak crosses the high threshold (p80) calibrated for that country. Three levels are derived from the peak reached during the episode: High (peak in [p80, p95[), Very high (peak in [p95, p99[), Extreme (peak ≥ p99). An episode is a continuous period above the threshold; episodes overlapping in time are grouped into clusters.

sonarq.title: Sonar — the quality of our data
sonarq.subtitle: What the Radar+ corpus contains, medium by medium, and how far you can trust it. Every segment of the timeline is traceable to a public, quantified verification — gaps and limits included.
sonarq.fresh_stale: Data is stale — incident in progress
sonarq.timeline_note: Hover a segment to read its verification. Dark notches are documented collection gaps.
sonarq.method_p1: A segment only enters the corpus if it is of very good quality, validated against an independent reference, and recomputable from the raw source.
sonarq.method_p2: Historical data is checked headline by headline against the production collection over their common window; below the 85% precision bar, we rebuild from archived front pages rather than admit the segment.
sonarq.method_p3: An unaudited segment is shown as "under watch", never "validated" — and the current collection is checked daily by an automated guard.
